description: Repair 10 Arabic titles. Four were cut off mid-word at exactly 60 characters, three opened with a stuffed keyword prefix and then repeated themselves, two had a doubled colon from a prefix bolted onto a title that already had one, and three carry machine-translation artefacts - including "وأوضح" (the verb "explained") stranded at the front of a title, and 조사 rendered as "جسيمات", the physics term for subatomic particles, in the h1 of a grammar guide. Replacements are hand-written, 30-52 characters, and checked against each other so the two near-duplicate app-comparison articles do not end up sharing a title. title column only; slug, description, keywords and content untouched, so no redirects are needed.
